title: About Me
subtitle: Engineering resilient enterprise platforms, leading cross-functional teams, and integrating cutting-edge AI and cloud technologies.
paragraphs: I am an Associate Technical Lead and Senior Software Engineer with nearly seven years of professional experience engineering mission-critical enterprise applications, distributed systems, and modern cloud architectures. Currently leading technical initiatives at Coderay Technologies, I focus on end-to-end software development, architectural evaluation, and technical mentorship.

My engineering background spans full-stack development with a deep emphasis on C# / .NET backend architecture, scalable RESTful API design, and modern frontend development with React and modern web ecosystems. Having progressed from hands-on software development to technical leadership, I bridge the gap between high-level business requirements and robust, maintainable codebases.

Across my career at Coderay Technologies, hSenid Business Solutions, Sri Lanka Telecom, and Peercore, I have delivered multi-tenant enterprise HR platforms, workflow automation engines, public sector queue management systems, and IoT telematics solutions. Today, I actively design and integrate Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI workflows to unlock real-world automation and intelligence.

pillars.title: Enterprise Architecture & .NET
pillars.description: Designing high-throughput, modular, and resilient backend systems following SOLID principles, microservices concepts, and domain-driven design.

pillars.title: Cloud & Azure Solutions
pillars.description: Architecting cloud-native solutions with Microsoft Azure, Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure OpenAI, and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.

pillars.title: IoT & System Integration
pillars.description: Connecting hardware, sensors, and telemetry pipelines using MQTT, ESP32 microcontrollers, device mapping, and real-time event streaming.

pillars.title: Generative & Agentic AI
pillars.description: Building next-generation intelligent applications utilizing Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, LLM orchestration, and autonomous agent tool-calling.

pillars.title: Data Engineering & Optimization
pillars.description: Optimizing high-volume relational and document stores including SQL Server, Oracle, and MongoDB through indexing, query tuning, and schema design.

pillars.title: Technical Leadership & Delivery
pillars.description: Guiding sprint engineering, conducting architecture reviews, mentoring engineers, and steering cross-functional collaboration across Product, QA, and DevOps.
